note: Enhanced PR Freelance scrape, 7-day window (2026-07-13 to 2026-07-20). Sources searched: LinkedIn (via indexed search only, no bot scraping), Indeed, CareerBuilder, ZipRecruiter, Mediabistro, The PR Net, The Work Crowd, Go Fractional. Deduplicated against all pr-freelance-scrape-*.json and daily-scrape-*.json reports from 2026-06-30 onward. Only leads scoring 55+ included. Note: mediabistro.com filtered job board could not be fetched (URL blocked by provenance rules) — Mediabistro coverage this run is search-index only. Two known-name listings (JIH PR, The PR Net #1745, Go Fractional Comms Director) were suppressed as already captured in prior runs.

leads.name: SJP Legal Talent (Chambers-ranked NewLaw provider, via The Work Crowd)
leads.industry: Flexible legal talent / NewLaw services to financial institutions and in-house legal teams

fitDetails.pr_remit: +20 — explicit PR strategy, media relations, earned media, founder positioning
fitDetails.sector_fit: +15 — legal / professional services selling into financial institutions; squarely in Mark's legal+PR ICP
fitDetails.workstream: +10 — thought leadership, executive positioning, reactive commentary, awards strategy
fitDetails.buyer_quality: 0 — direct operating-company buyer, no stated overflow/immediate need

intentDetails.apply_path: +5 — direct application form on The Work Crowd

leads.compensationText: £150–£1,500 (day-rate band as posted); ~1 day per month, 6 months initial
signals: Chambers & Partners ranked in NewLaw / Flexible Legal Staffing category — fresh credential to amplify
Explicitly 'investing in our external profile' — net-new comms function, no incumbent agency
Wants 'the contacts and judgement of an agency without the agency overhead' — direct anti-agency buying signal
Reports to Managing Director — founder-level access, short decision chain
leads.source: The Work Crowd jobs board (PR and comms), posted 2026-07-07
leads.notes: Grade B (combined 75) — best fit of the run. Legal-sector PR for a flexible-legal-talent business selling into financial institutions hits Mark's legal + finance ICP simultaneously. Target media named in the brief (The Lawyer, Legal Week, Legal Futures, Global Legal Post) is exactly the trade set a senior legal-PR operator owns. Low hours (1 day/month) caps revenue but the 6-month term plus 'scope to increase' makes it a land-and-expand. CAVEAT: UK market experience explicitly required — this is a fit only if Mark has UK legal-trade relationships. ACTION: apply with 2–3 named legal/B2B placements and a one-page 6-month plan (strategy → Chambers amplification → founder commentary programme).

leads.name: Capital One — Interim Head of Brand Marketing and PR (12-month contract)
leads.industry: Diversified financial services — credit cards, banking, lending

fitDetails.pr_remit: +20 — PR is named in the title and the remit
fitDetails.sector_fit: +15 — large-cap financial services, core ICP sector
fitDetails.workstream: +10 — brand narrative + earned media leadership at enterprise scale

intentDetails.apply_path: +5 — direct apply link through Go Fractional to the original posting

signals: Highest published rate in the pipeline this run: $160–$220/hr
12-month term at near-full-time hours — largest single contract value seen in this vertical
Interim head-of-function backfill at a major bank implies a departure or leave to cover
Go Fractional flags this as an external repost — the underlying req may have moved or closed
leads.source: Go Fractional job board (external repost of Capital One req)
leads.notes: Grade B (combined 75). Economics are far and away the best on the board — at 30–40 hrs/week for 12 months this is a near-full-time engagement, so it competes with Mark's whole book rather than slotting alongside it. Scored down hard on recency: posted ~3 months ago and Go Fractional explicitly disclaims any relationship with the company for this role. ACTION: verify the req is live on Capital One's own careers site before investing pitch time; if live, route through Capital One's contingent-labour channel rather than the aggregator.

leads.name: Dysphagia Healthcare Business (via The Work Crowd)
leads.industry: Healthcare / medtech — dysphagia (swallowing difficulties) patient and clinician market

fitDetails.pr_remit: +20 — pure media relations and coverage-securing brief
fitDetails.sector_fit: 0 — healthcare, outside the finance/legal/B2B core ICP

intentDetails.recency: 0 — posted 2026-07-16 (4 days, just outside the 72-hour bonus)
intentDetails.urgency_signals: +10 — campaigns and story pipeline already built, buyer needs execution now ('not looking for someone to create our PR')

leads.compensationText: £150–£1,500 (day-rate band as posted); ~1–2 days/month, ~6 months initial
signals: Highest urgency signal of the run — media database, campaigns and story pipeline are already built and waiting to be pitched
Buyer has self-diagnosed the gap as execution, not strategy — fastest possible path to billable work
Explicitly 'not typical Pharma messaging' — narrative-led rather than regulated medical comms
Scope may expand based on results — performance-linked growth path
leads.source: The Work Crowd jobs board (PR and comms), posted 2026-07-16
leads.notes: Grade B (combined 70). Off-ICP on sector but the cleanest execution brief in the batch: everything upstream is done and the buyer just wants placements. That maps directly to Mark's 'plug in fast, manage media' positioning. Risk is the stated preference for existing healthcare-journalist relationships — Mark would be competing against health-specialist freelancers. ACTION: pitch only if Mark wants healthcare category exposure; lead with pitch-conversion rate and named placements rather than sector credentials, and offer a paid 1-day trial pitch sprint to sidestep the relationships objection.
